title: GM Trade Remaining Mechanism Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Trade_ValidateRestrictions (RVA 0x12ec130) verifies trade restrictions on involved players using bitmask 0x3c0000 on [PlayerContract+0x8] (recently signed, no-trade clause, injury status).
claims.falsification_note: A trade package failing restriction mask 0x3c0000 is rejected immediately without evaluating AI acceptance.

claims.statement: Trade_CommitTransaction (RVA 0x132b040 / 0x1413be6e0) executes atomic transfer of players and picks across participating teams (two-team and multi-party).
claims.falsification_note: Executing trade transaction mutates roster and draft pick ownership permanently in franchise state.
